uniqueness_method: resolved pathname via os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(...)) AND OS file identity (st_dev, st_ino) for existing files
uniqueness_limits: SUBST, mapped network drives, 8.3 short-name aliases and unsupported reparse points were not exercised on this host and are not claimed
identity is observed during validation and the hash is read again during verification; a replacement between those two observations is not detected (TOCTOU, declared residual)
file_identity falls back to the canonical pathname on ANY OSError, not only on a missing file, so an operational stat failure degrades to a weaker comparison
nonzero st_dev/st_ino are trusted without a capability check; on non-NTFS, network or synthetic-inode filesystems this may not be a physical identity
the guard confines writers by path policy; it does not take an OS-level write inventory, so a writer that bypasses the helper is not detected by this report
csv_validation: header required, unique, exact row width, no surplus or absent cells
